candidates.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.5 with Enhanced Agentic Reasoning and Efficiency
candidates.description: OpenAI officially released GPT-5.5, its new flagship model, featuring significant improvements in agentic reasoning, tool use, and efficiency. It aims to match GPT-5.4's latency while offering higher intelligence, especially in coding and complex 'computer use' tasks.

candidates.title: DeepSeek Releases V4-Pro and V4-Flash Models Built on Huawei Ascend Chips
candidates.description: DeepSeek released its V4-Pro (1.6T parameters) and V4-Flash models, the first frontier models built entirely on Huawei Ascend 950PR chips. They feature a 1-million-token context window and are released under an MIT license.

candidates.title: Chinese Academy of Sciences Unveils 'ScienceOne 100' AI Model System for Scientific Research
candidates.description: The Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) revealed ScienceOne 100, a sophisticated AI model system designed to accelerate scientific research. It integrates multidisciplinary models for physics, mathematics, and biology, featuring tools like a 'literature compass' and an 'agent factory' with over 2,000 research tools.

candidates.title: AI Protein-Design Startup Profluent Forms $2.25 Billion Partnership with Eli Lilly
candidates.description: AI protein-design startup Profluent announced a strategic collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.25 billion. The partnership focuses on using Profluent’s large-scale foundation models to design custom 'recombinases' for precise DNA editing to treat genetic diseases.
